scope: Supporting public component contracts required by Flow documentation templates and documentation patterns.

decision.reason: Code Block and Copy Button are public component contracts because documentation templates and patterns need reusable source/copy behavior. Implementation remains blocked until audit gates and runtime work are scheduled.

existingInternalEvidence.finding: Contains an internal CodeBlock function for email layout.
existingInternalEvidence.decision: Do not treat this internal email helper as the public Code Block component because email markup has channel-specific constraints.

governanceCoverage: Code Block replaces raw pre/code and local source wrappers in migrated documentation pages.
Copy Button replaces local copy controls and owns clipboard feedback, disabled state, and accessible naming.
Email OTP/security code blocks remain governed by Email Template Layout, not Code Block.
nextRequiredWork: Add audit gates that fail on raw pre/code, local copy controls, local docs demo frames, local metadata pills, local docs-section surfaces, and local shell wrappers in migrated FlowDocs pages.
Then implement runtime React components or explicitly defer them before migrating FlowDocs adapters.
